title: Silent Yachts SY80 Solar-Electric Catamaran to Debut at Cannes Yachting Festival 2025
description: Silent Yachts introduces the SY80 solar-electric catamaran, debuting in Cannes. This sustainable vessel sets new standards in eco-friendly yachting.
html:
Silent Yachts Unveils SY80 Solar-Electric Catamaran

Silent Yachts has introduced its latest innovation, the 24.38-meter SY80 solar-electric catamaran, which is set to make its debut at the Cannes Yachting Festival from September 9-14, 2025. The first unit, already sold, showcases a 2-Deck configuration and includes four guest cabins, with both master and VIP suites. This launch signifies a significant advancement in the company’s commitment to solar-powered maritime solutions.

The SY80 is designed to offer versatility with three distinct layout options: 2-Deck, 3-Deck Open, and 3-Deck Closed, all featuring customizable deck arrangements. The initial model is equipped with a 360-degree helm station, a panoramic saloon, and a concealed garage for storing water toys. This catamaran is engineered for performance, boasting a top speed of 12 knots and a cruising speed of 7-8 knots. Its solar array has a capacity of 22.4 kWp, paired with battery options ranging from 522 to 696 kWh.

Innovative Design and Features of the SY80 Model

The SY80 catamaran exemplifies Silent Yachts’ dedication to sustainable innovation in marine design. The vessel’s architecture allows for seamless integration of solar technology, ensuring efficient energy use and minimal environmental impact. The 360-degree helm station provides comprehensive visibility, enhancing navigational capabilities, while the panoramic saloon offers an expansive view of the surrounding seascape.

In addition to its aesthetic and functional design, the SY80 includes a hidden garage, optimizing space for recreational equipment. This feature underscores the catamaran’s commitment to combining practicality with advanced technology. The SY80’s solar-electric propulsion system is a testament to Silent Yachts’ pioneering efforts in creating oceangoing vessels that rely solely on renewable energy sources.

Expanding the Solar-Powered Maritime Frontier

Silent Yachts continues to expand its solar-powered fleet with the introduction of the SY80, following the success of earlier models like the SY60. The Italian-built catamaran represents a significant step forward in the company’s mission to produce fully solar-sustainable oceangoing production yachts. The SY80’s ability to cruise up to 100 miles per day on solar power alone highlights the potential for sustainable maritime travel.

Founded by Heike and Michael Köhler, Silent Yachts has been at the forefront of solar-powered marine innovation since 2009, when they launched the Solarwave 46. This pioneering vessel was the first fully self-sufficient blue-water catamaran, developed after extensive testing of solar-powered propulsion systems. The SY80 continues this legacy, reinforcing Silent Yachts’ position as a leader in the development of environmentally responsible yachting solutions.

The launch of the SY80 solar-electric catamaran by Silent Yachts marks a significant milestone in the evolution of sustainable marine travel. With its innovative design and commitment to solar energy, the SY80 sets a new standard for oceangoing vessels. As Silent Yachts expands its solar-powered range, it continues to lead the way in creating eco-friendly yachting solutions that align with the growing demand for sustainable practices in the maritime industry.
